full_page.content:
1928, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 35 Cont.
Mary Kwitkowski 14 - paralysis not able to walk .. .... Mrs. Mathini - Tuberculosis + peaceful and beautiful - Deo Grat. 6 yr. boy Syrian Hall - Mastoids and Edgar Nelson 12 of Ecorse "Corsoma" in fearful pains
Aug. 25 Violet Trimonti (18) 2460 Baldwin Ave. fearfully burned leg Cos- tic-Soda - on neck and around ..... Two young ruffi.
Sinis Trouble
Aug. 30th Mrs. F. Marentette, enrolled four years ago To-day - then thought to be dying of tuberculosis - comes asking for help to start a poor neighbors' children to school. Fr. S. sent her to J. Caneff who gave her a check for $50.00 ... Same J. C. had not 50c a year ago to pay for his enrollment. Shortly afterwards he got employ- ment, where he works since. Recently his salary was raised to $ 100.00 per week.
September 5th.
Page 36 Aug. 31 Jerry Casey 70 8309 Rathbone Ave., operated on a year ago for can- cer of Jaw, now getting bad again, promises more fidelity in regard to Church and Sacraments. Enrolled yesterday by his daughter.
Mrs. M. Rabu - paralysed would like to be able to walk a little ... Mrs. K. Cleveland - Husband. Ch. V. McGrath - Wife & 4 ... - pneumonia - very sick Carl Fellhauer - Lumbago - Rheu. John Kiyanouski - Rose Miller - Amputation - diabetes
Mrs. Eliz. Kavanaugh 68, 2730 National Ave. Gall-stones & pertin- ites - given up by all in Hospital - Enrolled by phone, was decid- edly hopeful next A.M. Now improving.
